title: What Does This God Do in Society

entries.value: It is the war-god or patron of those who fight
It is the favourite god of the ruling class
It is the patron of an important profession — smiths, sailors, healers
It is a devil-figure that must be placated to avert disaster
It provides healing, protection from illness, and aid in danger
It is the patron of an illegal but inevitable trade
It hallows the law, consecrates oaths, and punishes oath-breakers
It is flatly illegal and hated by most of the official establishment
It is the protector of an ethnic or social minority
It provides good harvests, fertile animals, and healthy children
It is the patron of the former rulers of the land — Roman, pre-Roman
It guards particular sacred places — springs, groves, stones, boundaries
It provides wisdom and prophetic insight to those who seek it
It gives good luck to its petitioners
It is a protector of the weak and the humble
It empowers those seeking righteous revenge for wrongs
It bestows material wealth on petitioners
It protects the soul in the afterlife
It explains the creation and order of the world
It prevents some type of common disaster — flood, plague, harvest-failure
